display_long_description:
This is the base game with one level but it won't be easy to complete it! Other maps can be purchased in game.

What if your arms were bananas?

Welcome to Banana Climber, a physics-based VR climbing challenge where you climb using two bananas instead of arms. This is the Full Game (Beta) release, featuring multiple maps, leaderboards, and progression. The first map is free, with additional maps unlockable via in-app purchase.

TWO BANANAS. ONE CLIMB.
Your hands are bananas, literally. Each banana reacts to physics, momentum, and impact. Every swing, grab, and launch depends entirely on your control. Grab ledges and hooks, swing upward, miss a grip… and fall. No button-press climbing, only precision, timing, and physics.
 

TIMER & SCOREBOARDS
Track your performance per map:
 Finish Time if you reach the top
 Maximum Height Reached if you fall
 Individual results per map
Climb faster. Climb higher. Beat your best.

A PURE PHYSICS CHALLENGE
Made for VR players who enjoy physics-driven movement, vertical challenges, skill-based progression, and high-retry gameplay. Strong arms help but a sharp mind matters too.

RECORD & SHARE YOUR CLIMBS
Show off clean runs, insane saves, or painful falls.
